description.text: Teaching ObjectiveAfter the course you will be equipped the knowledge of software engineering and the development of advanced technology, with software development and management ability.Main CoursesFundamental of Program Design, Object-Oriented Programming, Higher Mathematics, Discrete Mathematics, Operating System, Computer Network, Principle of Computer systems, Database Principle and Application, Introduction to Software Engineering, Software Test TechnologyInternship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design.

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Sichuan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. Health certificate(optional)Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency testIELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker.7. Financial guarantee letterPhotocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency. 8. Certificate of No-Criminal Record

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
